public_gates: design a valid-offset rerun of the projection-aware boundary outcome gate
do not reinterpret M518 invalid replay as controller failure
do not train or promote checkpoint
forbidden_shortcuts: do not add privileged actor inputs
do not silently change M518 results
do not reuse original obstacle geometry for projected rows
do not count reset or zero-current controls as wrong-history proof
hypothesis: M518 failed because the pre-registered offset set included an invalid late tail offset for near-terminal left snapshots; rerunning the same projection-aware gate with valid offsets can produce an interpretable outcome classification.
success_criteria: identify the M518 invalid offset pattern
pre-register the valid offset set for M520
define how M520 should classify fast correction versus margin-only or positive proof
failure_criteria: redesign treats M518 invalid replay as controller failure
training or checkpoint promotion is performed

commands.name: valid_offset_projection_outcome_redesign
commands.command: Use the M518 summary and invalid-tail audit to design the M520 valid-offset projection-aware outcome gate.

decision_rule: M519 should admit M520 only if the next run keeps M517 semantics and removes the globally invalid tail offset without changing actor inputs or promotion state.
next_blocker: M520 should rerun the projection-aware boundary outcome gate with tail offsets 0,2,4.
